title: The Lantern Line
subtitle: Hidden until the rule behind it is satisfied
description: The lantern line does not appear on the canvas until its
prerequisite rule is met: `hideUntilDependenciesComplete` hides the
quest until the same rule the card counts -- honouring `minRequired`
and the started-based modes, not just a flat 'all done'.
The rule here is one bridge, complete. The lanterns were always
going up; the canvas simply declines to promise them early.
